faqs.question: Where do you study?
faqs.answer: Abdul Samad is pursuing a Bachelor of Computer Science with a focus on Cloud Data Engineering (2022 – 2026). His studies cover data structures, algorithms, databases, operating systems, networks and software engineering alongside cloud and data technologies.
keywords: where do you go to school

faqs.question: Tell me about your education
faqs.answer: He completed FSc Pre-Engineering (2020 – 2022) and is currently completing a Bachelor of Computer Science focused on Cloud Data Engineering (2022 – 2026).

faqs.question: What is your major?
faqs.answer: His major is Computer Science with a specialization track in Cloud Data Engineering.

faqs.question: When will you graduate?
faqs.answer: He is expected to graduate in 2026. Until then he's balancing his degree with hands-on projects and continuous learning.

faqs.question: What is FSc Pre-Engineering?
faqs.answer: FSc Pre-Engineering is his intermediate (higher secondary) education completed between 2020 and 2022 — it gave him a strong foundation in mathematics and physics before his Computer Science degree.

faqs.question: What subjects do you study?
faqs.answer: His coursework includes data structures and algorithms, databases, operating systems, computer networks, software engineering, discrete mathematics — plus cloud and data technologies as part of his Cloud Data Engineering track.

faqs.question: What is your GPA?
faqs.answer: Abdul maintains a strong academic record alongside his development work, but the exact figure is best shared directly by him — message him and he'll be happy to discuss it.

faqs.question: How do you balance study and work?
faqs.answer: He plans his week with fixed study blocks and fixed development blocks. University builds his fundamentals; projects build his portfolio — and each makes the other stronger.

faqs.question: Do you take online courses?
faqs.answer: Yes — beyond university, he constantly learns from online platforms. His certificates from freeCodeCamp and AWS Educate are part of his continuous learning routine.

faqs.question: Why did you choose Cloud Data Engineering?
faqs.answer: He chose it because data is the engine behind every modern product — and cloud platforms are how that engine runs at scale. Combining data engineering with full stack development lets him build complete, intelligent systems.

faqs.question: Do you build projects for university?
faqs.answer: Yes — university assignments and semester projects have pushed him into areas like data structures, database design and system development, which complement his personal projects.

faqs.question: What is the website of your university?
faqs.answer: He prefers to share university details directly. For any verification or academic queries, email him at mr.abdulsamadabdullah@gmail.com and he'll be glad to help.

faqs.question: Is university worth it for developers?
faqs.answer: He believes university builds strong fundamentals — algorithms, systems and theory — while self-learning builds practical skills. He does both: degree for the foundation, projects for the craft.

faqs.question: Are you good at mathematics?
faqs.answer: Yes — his Pre-Engineering background and Computer Science coursework gave him solid mathematics: discrete math, logic, probability and algorithm analysis, all essential for good engineering.

faqs.question: Do you know data structures and algorithms?
faqs.answer: Yes — DSA is core to his Computer Science degree. He's comfortable with arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, hashing and common algorithms, and applies them in real projects.
